result.description: Cloud database/spreadsheet hybrid for building collaborative apps, workflows and automations on structured data.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 integrations (self-registered at /create/oauth, auth-code flow) for multi-user apps; personal access tokens (Bearer) created per user at /create/tokens.
result.access_detail: Gate audit (1): any developer registers OAuth integration self-serve; to let other users authorize, only support email, privacy policy URL and ToS URL are needed. No Airtable review/approval step found in docs. End users can also create their own PATs. (2): pricing page states no API plan restriction; MCP docs say available on all plans (free included). Rate limits only (5 req/s per base); Airtable reserves right to tier limits by plan. Enterprise admins may restrict third-party integrations in their own orgs, and some endpoints (Enterprise API) need Enterprise plan, but core API is not gated.
result.api_notes: REST JSON API: records CRUD, bases, tables, fields/schema (metadata), webhooks, comments, plus Enterprise API endpoints. Rate limit 5 req/s per base, 50 req/s per PAT user; 429 then 30s wait. Official airtable.js client.

evidence.quote: You can access the OAuth integrations panel at /create/oauth.
The personal access tokens panel can be accessed at /create/tokens.
This will enable other users to authorize your integration.
The server is available to all users on all plans.
The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects, and relies on standard HTTP codes to signal operation outcomes.
The API is limited to 5 requests per second per base.
Airtable's MCP server lets you connect AI tools directly to your Airtable bases.
Personal access tokens can be used to make requests to all public Airtable API endpoints, including endpoints that were previously limited in availability such as the Metadata API endpoints.
